book.name: Yohannisa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: He wode Yesusi Yohannisappe bollara daro asa bana kaallizaade ooththizayssanne xammaqizayssa Farsaaweti siyida.
Gido attiin xammaqizayti iza kaallizaytappe attiin izi xammaqibeenna.
Iza gishshas haasayettizayssa Farsaaweti siyidayssa Yesusi eridi Yuhuda dere aggidi Galila dere simmi bides.
Izi hee bishin Samaariyara aadhdhi baanayssi izas attonttaaz gidides.
Hessa gishshas Sikaaro geetettizaso Samaariya katama bides. Sikaara Yaaqoobey ba naa Yooseefes immida biittaa achchan dawus.
Heenkka Yaaqoobe haaththa ollay dees. Yesusi oge hemetti daaburda gishshas he ollay achchan uttides. Wodeykka gallassafe usuppun saate mala.
He wode issi Samaariya dere maccas dizaara haaththe duuqqanaas
he haaththaa ollaako yadus. Yesusikka izo, «Tana haaththe ushsha» gides.
Hessi hanishin Yesusa kaallizayti quma shammana katama bida.

Hinna Samaariya maccassaya Yesusa, «Ne Ayhuda as gida uttada waanada tana Samaariya maccas, ‹Haaththe ushsha› ga oychchay?» gadus; iza hessa giday Ayhuda asaassinne Samaariya asas gaagoteththi dontta gishshassa.
Yesusikka izis, «Xoossa imotaynne nena, ‹Tana haaththe ushsha› gizaadey izi oonakkonne ne erizaakko ne iza woossanaas bessees. Izikka nees de7o haaththe immanakkoshin» gides.
Izakka izas, «Godoo! Nees haaththe duuqqiza miishshi deenna; haaththaa ollayka daro ciimma; histtiin ne de7o haath awappe demmanee?
Ne hayssa haaththa ollaza nuus immida nu aawaa Yaaqoobeppe aadhdhay? Izinne iza nayti iza mehetikka hayssa ha ollaafe haath uyida» gadus.
Yesusi izis, «Hayssa ha haaththaafe uyizay wuri nam7anththo saamettidi zaari hara uyanashin.
Ta immiza haaththe uyizaadey gidikko mernaas mulekka saamettenna; gaasoykka ta immiza haath uyizaades mernaa de7os pulttiza pultto haaththe gidana» gides.
Maccassayakka, «Godoo! Hayssafe guye tana haaththi saamontta malanne qasseka ta haaththe duuqqana haa yontta mala hessa ne giza haaththaa mala haaththe taas immarkkii?» gadus.
Yesusikka izo, «Baada ne azinaa xeyga ekkada ya» gides.
Maccassayakka zaarada, «Taas azinay deenna» gadus; iza hizgiin Yesusi, « ‹Ne taas azinay deenna› guussay tumukko.
Gaasoykka kase nees ichchashu azinati deettes; qasse ha7i nenara dizayssi ne azina gidenna; hessa gishshas ne tumu gadasa» gides.
Maccassaya izas, «Godoo! Neni nabe gididayssa ta ha7i eradis.
Kase nu Aawati hayssa zumaa bolla goynnida; intte qasse, ‹Asay goynnanaas bessizasoy Yerusalaamenkko!› geeta» gadus.
Yesusikka izis, «Hanne maccassayee, Xoossaa aawaas hayssa zumaa bolla woykko Yerusalaamen intte goynnontta wodey yaanayssa ammana.
Intte intte erontta Xoossas goynneeta; nu gidikko asas atoteththi Ayhudappe gidida gishshas nuni nu eriza Xoossas goynnoos.
Gido attiin tumu goynnizayti Xoossaa Aawaas Ayananinne tuman goynniza wodey buro yaana; haray attoshin ha7ikka yides. Xoossay aawaykka koyzay hessa mala goynnizayta.
Xoossi ba hu7es Ayana; iza goynnizayti ayananinne tuman goynnanaas bessees» gides.
Maccassayakka, «Kirstoosi yaanayssa ta erays; izi yiidi hanizaaz ubbaa nuus yootana» gadus.
Yesusikka izis, «Ha7i nenara haasayzay ta iza» gides.
Hessi hanishin iza kaallizayti ba bidasoppe simmida. Yesusi Maccassara haasayzayssa malalettida; gido attiin, «Hanne ay koyay? Woykko hannira aazas haasayay?» giidi oonikka oychchibeenna.
Hessafe guye maccassaya otoza heen aggaagada gede katama baada asaas,
«Ta ooththidaaz wursi taas yootidaade haa yiidi be7ite; oonee erizay Xoossi tiyda Kirstoosi izakkonnee!» gadus.
Asaykka katamaappe kezidi Yesusaakko bides.
He wode Yesusa kaallizayti Yesusa, «Astamaaree! Quma ma» giidi woossida.
Izi qasse, «Intte eronttay ta miza qumay taas dees» gides.
Hessa gishshas iza kaallizayti, «Aykko miza kath asi izas ehideeshaa?» giidi ba giddon haasayettida
Yesusikka isttas zaaridi, «Ta qumay tana kiittida ta Aawaa shene oosonne iza ooso polo.
Intte qasse, ‹Kaththa maxay gakkanaas buro oyddu aginay attides› geeta gidekketii? Qasse tani gidikko inttena, ‹Dhoqqu giidi kaththay maxa gakkidayssa xeellite› gays.
Maxizaadey ba damoza ekkana; mernaas gidiza ayfe shiishshana; hessa gishshas zerizaadeynne maxizaadey issife ufayettana.
Hessa gishshas issaadey zerana; hara asi maxana geetettiza leemisoy tuma.
Ta inttena intte daaburonttayssa maxana mala yeddadis; harati ooson daaburda; gido attiin intte istta daabursan go7ettideta» gides.
Maccassaya, «Ta ooththidaaz ubbaa taas izi yootides» gaada asaas markkattida mala katamaappe daro Samaariya asay izan ammanides.
Hessa gishshas Samaariya asay Yesusaakko yiidi izi isttakon gam7ana mala woossides; izikka nam7u gallas heen gam7ides.
Iza qaalaa siyidi daro asay iza ammanides.
Maccassayokka, «Ha7i nu iza ammanizay ne yootida qaalaa gishshas xalla gidontta nunikka nu baggara izappe siyida gishshassinne tumappe izi dere ashshizaade gididayssa erida gishshassa» gida.
Yesusi Shuumeza Naaza Paththides
Yesusi Samaariyan nam7u gallas gam7idaappe guye Galila bides.
Izi ba baggara, «Nabey ba deren bonchchettenna» gi yootides.
Gido attiin izi Galila biin Galila asay iza lo7eththi mokki ekkides; gaasoykka Paaziga ba7aale bonchchana Yerusalaame bidason heen dishin izi ooththidayssa wursi be7ida gishshassa.
Hessafe guye Yesusi haaththe woyne cajje ooththida Galila dere giddon diza Qaana geetettiza katamaa nam7anththo bides. He wode Qifirnahoomen izas nay sakettida issi kawo shuumey dees.
Izikka Yesusi Yuhuda dereppe gede Galila yidayssa siyidi Yesusaakko bides. Yesusi duge Qifirnahoome wodhdhana malanne daro sakettidi hayqqana giza naaza paththana mala Yesusa woossides.
Yesusikka izas, «Intte gita malaatatanne malalisizaaz be7ontta aykkoka ammanekketa» gides.
Shuumezikka zaaridi, «Godoo! Ta naazi hayqqontta elela wodhdharkkii!» gides.
Yesusikka iza, «Neni neso ba! Naazi paxides» gides; addezikka Yesusi izas yootida qaalaa ammanidi soo simmi bides.
Izi soo bishin iza ashkarati izara ogen gaaggidi, «Ne naazi paxides» giidi izas yootida.
Shuumezikka naazi ay saaten paxidaakko istta zaari oychchides. Isttika izas, «Qamma
gallassafe laappun saaten iza michchizayssi aggides» gida.
Naaza aawaykka Yesusi, «Ne naazi paxides» giday he istti izas yootiza wode gididayssa erides. Hessa gishshas he gallassafe oykkidi izinne izaso asay wuri Yesusa ammanida.
Hayssi malatay Yesusi Yuhudappe Galila yiidi ooththida nam7anththo malata.

footnotes.text: Duuqqanaas: Duuqqanaas gizayssa issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan Tikkanaas geettes.
Qamma: Qamma gizayssa issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan zine geettes.
